about: The sample games a release packs for the editor's Samples tab (Code/Tools/pack-samples.py): each one's folder here, its name, one line on what it is, and its picture.

samples.name: Sky Hopper
samples.description: A small 3D platformer: five levels of coins, enemies and hazards, three lives, stars and best scores saved, and gamepad support throughout.

samples.name: PaperKid
samples.description: An arcade paper-route game: five town blocks to deliver on, traffic and pedestrians in the way, and a live minimap.

samples.name: Snowline
samples.description: A snowboard time trial with tricks on three courses of generated terrain, opened by medals, with a ghost of your best run.

samples.name: Lamplight
samples.description: A night-time manor heist in pure stealth: five levels from the gardens to the vault, past guards who see by their lanterns.

samples.name: Masquerade
samples.description: Social stealth at a masked ball, alone against bots or with up to four players over the network.

samples.name: Shader Gallery
samples.description: A hall of custom shader lessons, each a short commented shader on its own plinth, surface shaders first.
